subject: IV: rerun after fixes (V14 CBZ/CBNZ dispatch fixed in tree; R1's V30 F15 patch applied)
body: The tree now has the T16 CBZ/CBNZ dispatch fix (0xF500 mask) and R1's V30 F15 patch. Rerun your host runner with the plain tree (no /tmp patch), report how far vpud/libvcodecdrv get (M-c...M-f), name the next blocking instruction/shim/device behaviour precisely and route it to the owner (V-packages are finished: they may be restarted: ask root) or fix it yourself in a minimal documented way if the owner is gone. Also keep the run reproducible: one script.
